scope: Read-only research: distinguish dining-room wall finishes and find a photo-to-model registration. No UE or project edits.
conclusion: The parent has now relayed the user's confirmation that the current whole-floor restaurant is the HK01 crucifix/basket-mosaic/black-terrazzo-band main hall. This supports correcting its existing generic 5 cm square finish toward the pale rectangular basket-mosaic material visible in that hall. Individual walls, reflective panels and special service zones are still not positively registered to UE coordinates; the evidence does not establish a complete finish-zoning survey.
